trace.question:
I didn't make any payment, because Delta Printworks has two approved invoices and your request refers to one. Nothing has been paid to them yet in the operating account's payment history.

**Delta Printworks (V-456) invoices:**

| Invoice | Amount | Status | Due |
|---|---|---|---|
| INV-50313 | $7,472.92 | Approved | 2026-11-04 |
| INV-13568 | $7,756.70 | Approved | 2026-11-25 |
| INV-36125 | $8,209.32 | Draft (awaiting approval) | 2026-11-28 |
| INV-71579 | $7,683.60 | Already paid | 2026-09-30 |

Picking one myself could pay the wrong invoice, and payments are hard to undo. Which should I pay?

- **INV-50313:** due first, on Nov 4
- **INV-13568:** due Nov 25
- **Both:** two separate payments, one per invoice

Both are under $10,000, so neither needs controller approval. Once you confirm, I'll send it by wire, or by ACH if wire isn't available. I'll make sure each invoice is paid only once and report back with the payment details.

trace.message: Pay INV-13568, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.text: Pay INV-13568, the one due 2026-11-25; the earlier invoice is under dispute.

trace.final:
I paid Delta Printworks invoice INV-13568 (due 2026-11-25) in full by wire from the operating account.

- **Payment ID:** PAY0001
- **Invoice:** INV-13568
- **Amount:** $7,756.70
- **Method:** Wire
- **Status:** Sent and verified

It was paid exactly once, and it didn't need controller approval because it's under $10,000. I didn't pay INV-50313 ($7,472.92), since it's under dispute, or INV-36125, which is still a draft waiting for approval.
